propositions: Help artifacts must be generated deterministically from immutable parser factories with --check mode validating completeness, staleness, and non-determinism.
Top-level help (--help and rebar help <cmd>) must serve committed generated bytes before operation composition, config parsing, store mount, or handler resolution.
All visible canonical commands appear once in grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes; compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow approved rules.
Parser factories must be enriched with per-argument help=, description, epilog, and SUPPRESS to provide prose home for curated text (no hand-authored tables concatenated after generation).
Free-text later --help, malformed global syntax, unknown commands, streams, and exit codes remain valid per historical compatibility contract.
